notes: Modified cash basis governmental funds; business-type funds on accrual basis (net position). Treated as cash basis; beginning/ending cash = total governmental fund balances (no liabilities; all assets are cash, CDs, county treasurer cash). Transfers net to zero in Total column (General +6,025, nonmajor -6,025); recorded gross. Balance sheet uses government-wide Statement of Net Position Total column (mixes governmental modified cash and business-type accrual). Business-type reported receipts = total operating revenues 168,369 + interest 2,428 (no single printed total). Attempt 2 (2026-10-28): General Fund detail now recorded per department column of the Combining Statement of General Fund Departments (pp15-16; General, Community Development, Rescue, Police, Fire on p15; Pool, Cedar Valley Center, Village Office, Library, Park on p16), each department with its function: General/Village Office general government, Community Development economic development, Rescue/Police/Fire public safety, Pool/Cedar Valley Center/Library/Park culture/recreation; non-capital function sums tie to the p5 statement (74,572 / 9,186 / 50,611 / 90,493). The General Fund budgetary comparison (p10) is not recorded to avoid double counting. 'Rental and fees' statement line is mostly Rescue fees (18,384) so Ambulance Fees with review; pool admissions are Recreation Fees. 'Salaries and benefits' recorded as salaries and wages (dominant). Zero-actual budget lines (transfers, capital projects expenditure) included with amount 0. Statement of cash flows (p8-9) not used (cash basis). Read pages 1-16 of 16.
